title: Blue Marble (August 2004)
provider: MODIS / NASA Earth Observatory via NASA GIBS
purpose: Offline geographic reference basemap for a fictional RTS exercise
acknowledgment: NASA GIBS / MODIS / NASA Earth Observatory
use_conditions: NASA imagery guidance permits educational/informational use including graphical simulations, with acknowledgment and no endorsement implied. No NASA logo is used. See linked media-use guidance for exceptions.
game_projection: x=(longitude-118)*60*cos(24 degrees); y=(latitude-18)*60; x east, y north, nautical miles
limitations: Historical satellite composite, not live imagery. The game uses a flat local distance approximation; the basemap does not add coastline collision, bathymetry or terrain masking adjudication.
